errors.text_span: Die vertikale Achse listet die verschiedenen Branchen und Betriebsgrößen auf
errors.evidence: In the figure, the categories are on the vertical axis, but the description also implies the horizontal axis is the percentage axis; however the chart is actually a horizontal bar chart with categories on the vertical axis and values on the horizontal axis. This part is mostly correct, but later it refers to the bars as if grouped by branch/size without noting the two separated sections. No separate legend exists.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind in Blau gehalten und repräsentieren jeweils eine Branche oder Betriebsgröße.
errors.evidence: The bars are indeed blue, but each bar corresponds to a specific labeled category; describing them generically as 'a branch or size' is imprecise and fails to map individual bars to their visible labels as requested.

errors.text_span: der das Gastgewerbe darstellt, erreicht fast 50%
errors.evidence: The Gastgewerbe bar is slightly below 50%, around 48-49%, so 'fast 50%' is acceptable as an approximation but slightly overstated.

errors.text_span: während der niedrigste Balken, der das Baugewerbe darstellt, knapp über 0 liegt
errors.evidence: The Baugewerbe bar is around 9%, not just above 0.

errors.text_span: die Kleinstbetriebe (1-9) den höchsten Anteil aufweisen, während größere Betriebe (250+) den niedrigsten Anteil haben
errors.evidence: Among the four size categories, Mittlere Betriebe (50-249) is highest at about 38%, and Kleinstbetriebe (1-9) is lowest at about 19%. The stated ordering is reversed and incorrect.

The description does not mention that the chart includes two visually separated sections (industries above, firm sizes below) with a noticeable gap between them, which is a visible structural feature.
The description does not state that the bars are ordered roughly descending by length within the industry section and within the firm-size section, as visible in the chart.

The y-axis category ordering and the fact that the horizontal axis uses a linear scale with ticks every 5 from 0 to 50 are only partially described; the description omits the full axis label as shown in the figure's title/caption context and does not specify that the plot is a horizontal bar chart beyond implying it.

The description does state the purpose, but it omits the explicit caption-level framing that the chart shows the degree of affectedness by the minimum wage increase across industries and firm sizes; however this is largely covered already, so this is not a separate major omission.
